name: Dialog Group Berhad
overview: 2026 年，公司未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订事项；所披露的公告主要为季度业绩、股息除权、ESOS 新股发行及股东大会相关事宜。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not disclose any expansion, new business, reduction, divestment, or contract awards for its business segments; the announcements were mainly quarterly results, dividend ex-date notices, ESOS new share issuances, and general meeting matters.
